description.p: I.K.E. (Internet Kontrol Experience) is a light web browser focused on privacy: no telemetry, no accounts, no sponsored content, with ad blocking and fingerprinting protection built in. Pages are rendered by Qt WebEngine, the Chromium engine.

ul.li: A shield with five protection levels, set globally or per site, and "Repair this site" when a page breaks
Ad and tracker blocking with the EasyList, EasyPrivacy and uBlock filter lists, updated daily
Fingerprinting protection that changes identifying values from site to site
Encrypted password vault with autofill and a generator, passkeys and security keys
Horizontal or vertical tabs, tab groups, workspaces, containers, split view and private windows
User scripts in the Greasemonkey style, reader mode, picture-in-picture and page dark mode
Follows the desktop theme, or uses the optional "I.K.E. Cyber" theme

description.p: In the Flatpak, I.K.E. is updated by Flatpak; its own updater stays off.
Help, About tells which video and audio formats the engine plays and how old the engine is.
